title: Optimize D3 Diagram Drag Performance With Benchmark
description: Optimize the D3 force diagram and design diagram drag performance in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx for real-time smooth behavior. The drag is currently laggy due to: (1) simulation tick calling setDiagramNodes on every tick causing React re-renders at 60fps, (2) DRAG_THROTTLE_MS=50 (20fps) in design diagram onNodeDrag, (3) updateNodesFromSimulation creating new node arrays on every tick. Fix by: batching simulation ticks via requestAnimationFrame, removing the 50ms throttle and using RAF instead, and adding a Playwright benchmark test in index.tsx that measures drag frame time and asserts it stays under 16ms (60fps).
summary: Fixed undo/redo for delete piece in design app. Root cause: `recordEdit` in both `KitDiffAppStore` and `PlainKitDiffAppStore` only recorded edits when `isTransactionActive` was true. The delete hotkey calls `store.execute("semio.designApp.deleteSelected")` without a wrapping transaction, so no edit was pushed to `pastTransactionsStack` and undo had nothing to revert. Fix: removed the `isTransactionActive` guard from `recordEdit` in both classes — when active, edits still go to `_currentTransactionStack`/`currentStack`; when not active, edits go directly to `pastTransactionsStack`, making every atomic kit-modifying operation undoable. Extended `verifyDesignUndoRedo` test to cover delete→undo→redo cycle.
